defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_rebuild.symptom: python -m venv failed with WinError 5 when tools/dev.py was started by another project's venv interpreter
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_rebuild.cause: dev.py used sys.executable, which may be a different project's venv interpreter
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_rebuild.fix: base_python() resolves the base interpreter the running one was created from

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_rebuild.symptom: python -m venv exited 1 with 'Permission denied: pyvenv.cfg' while python.exe, pip and pyvenv.cfg were all present and usable
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_rebuild.cause: transient file lock (Windows antivirus real-time scan) on a freshly extracted tree; reproduced outside dev.py
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_rebuild.fix: ensure_project_venv() validates interpreter usability instead of the creator's exit code, with a bounded retry and a clear failure message

defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_rebuild.symptom: npm ci failed with EALLOWSCRIPTS: '--allow-scripts is not allowed in project-scoped installs'
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_rebuild.cause: the launcher forwarded the caller's environment, including NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_SCRIPTS injected by an outer npm exec wrapper
defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_rebuild.fix: npm_environment() removes npm's own lifecycle/invocation markers case-insensitively (Windows upper-cases env names) while keeping real npm config such as registry and cache

observations: npm reported 'allow-scripts' for 5 packages (dsh-subprocess-local, koffi, node-pty, protobufjs, @google/genai) whose install scripts are not covered by allowScripts. npm ci still exited 0 and the real Harness integration passed all 77 controlled model calls in this tree, so no required native module was left unusable by this path. Recorded as an observation with evidence rather than silently ignored.

The integration run's fixture HTTP server logs a WinError 10054 ConnectionResetError while shutting down a real connection; the run still exits 0 with ok=true. This is the documented fixture-teardown diagnostic.
